entities.summary: The Aterazawa Line  is a railway line in Yamagata Prefecture, Japan, operated by East Japan Railway Company. It connects Kita-Yamagata Station in Yamagata with Aterazawa Station in Ōe. All trains run through to and from Yamagata Station.
